reasons.structuremap-definition: StructureMap source/target context and target-path definitions are not validated.
reasons.measure-definition: MeasureReport group consistency against a Measure definition is not checked.
reasons.expression-definition: Definition-level FHIRPath static validity and constraint-key consistency are not checked.
reasons.snapshot-definition: StructureDefinition snapshot and inheritance consistency is not validated.
reasons.terminology-version: The offline validators carry different terminology versions; these codes differ in the pinned oracle.
reasons.publisher-policy: HL7 publisher-specific workgroup and standards-status requirements are not checked.
reasons.cql-validation: CQL library availability and compiled expressions are not checked.
reasons.definition-resolution: The pod does not resolve external canonical definitions for these definition resources.
reasons.terminology-filter: The pod does not validate terminology definition filters against a terminology service.
reasons.xhtml-reference: Narrative hyperlink and image-fragment resolution is outside the current XHTML checks.
reasons.terminology-display: Supplied terminology display text is not checked against reference terminology.
reasons.profile-invariant: The definition/resource invariant reported by the oracle is not evaluated by the pod.
reasons.bundle-reference: The oracle applies additional Bundle-relative reference identity rules.
reasons.extension-slicing: Closed sub-extension membership is not fully checked for this definition.
reasons.code-system-definition: The pod does not check CodeSystem property uniqueness or all-system ValueSet consistency.
reasons.conceptmap-definition: The pod does not validate ConceptMap source/target code and ValueSet membership.
reasons.valueset-definition: The pod does not check ValueSet definition version syntax or terminology consistency.
reasons.attachment-integrity: Attachment data/hash/size consistency is not checked.
reasons.contained-identity: Additional contained-resource identity checks are not evaluated.
reasons.canonical-fragment: Canonical fragment references are not resolved by the pod.
reasons.oracle-unavailable: Validator_cli 6.10.4 did not produce a usable outcome in prior repeated runs; explicitly excluded before comparison, never counted as agreement.
